title: A more alive Evia and one learner profile
details: Evia now looks around evenly instead of favouring the lower-left of the screen
Her idle animation now includes a soft pulse, rolling glow, tiny hops, pop and dim reactions, and small rolls
After 10 seconds without interaction Evia gently falls asleep and wakes with a small brighten and pop on the next touch
The learner name on the home screen is now the single profile editor for name, course, dates, working pattern and online portfolio address
The duplicate Edit course details route has been removed after setup
summary: Evia feels more alive while learner details now have one clear home.
changes: Added pulse, rolling glow, hop, pop, dim and sleep/wake animations
Unified learner profile under the home learner name
Added working hours and working days to learner profile
Refreshed the offline shell to v113
